BiblicalUsage: Pissah means abundance, plenty, a spreading out. It stands once, in Psalms 72:16, in the prayer for the king: a handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains, whose fruit shall shake like Lebanon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can make a handful feed a mountain, and His kingdom grows from small beginnings.
